decisions.reason: The formwork profile system sits at the core of the firm's precast-concrete formwork know-how and had its own page in both 2018 and 2019, so the firm can readily interpret its market feedback and keep improving it.
Shuttering magnet blocks are a staple product built directly on the firm's established magnetic formwork knowledge, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and refine it at low cost.
This magnetic formwork component had its own page in both years and is closely related to the firm's existing expertise, which signals strategic commitment and strong capacity to develop it further.

Although only mentioned on the website, this component extends the firm's core magnetic technology, so its accumulated knowledge supports keeping it, even though it is somewhat more exposed to range consolidation, as happened with the magnetic strips.
